sources.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked four-view architectural construction board for a CityPrompt LEGO building variant
Primary request: Design one coherent, physically buildable Large Art Museum - Folded Titanium Pavilion from the catalogue contract below and show that exact same building in four equal panels in a precise 2 by 2 grid.
Panel 1: dead-front orthographic elevation, complete building visible. Panel 2: pedestrian-height front-right architectural survey oblique. Panel 3: rear-left oblique proving every material and structural system wraps the secondary elevations. Panel 4: high aerial roof-plan oblique proving roof topology, courts, spans, and equipment.
Catalogue contract: A civic art museum is composed from five colliding but continuously clad titanium-zinc gallery volumes, including two rolled shells, three folded wedges, a glazed central canyon and one suspended rectilinear gallery bridge above a deep public entry.
Building lock: 88 m by 64 m, four occupied gallery levels; five independently legible but joined masses form one weather-tight composition, two are smooth rolled shells, three are sharply folded wedges, a full-height glazed canyon exposes the lobby, and one rectilinear gallery bridge cantilevers above the central entry without becoming a random pile of disconnected shards.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm-light-grey architectural studio ground and backdrop, no neighbors, trees, cars or people.
Style/medium: premium photoreal architectural survey photography and physically plausible construction reference, not concept art.
Lighting/mood: neutral bright overcast survey illumination with soft contact shadows and controlled glass reflections, consistent in every panel.
Materials/textures: small-scale matte titanium-zinc shingles; silver perforated metal screen; pale architectural concrete plinth; charcoal steel shadow joints; neutral low-iron atrium glass; warm occupied gallery and lobby depth; dark zinc roof seams and concealed drainage.
Constraints: exact same coherent building topology, storey datums, structural bays, openings, entrances, material zones and roof in all four panels; credible load paths; real recessed openings and physical screens; thin neutral gutters; whole building in every frame; no labels, text, signs, logos or watermark.
Avoid: random crumpled foil, disconnected floating shards, generic silver box, blue mirror atrium, paper-thin walls, impossible cantilever, blank rear elevation; perspective distortion, blank sides, changed geometry between panels, entourage, dramatic sunset.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: shadow-neutral 3 by 2 construction and occupied-depth material board for the exact Large Art Museum - Folded Titanium Pavilion shown in Image 1
Input images: Image 1 is the approved four-view geometry, palette, construction-scale and optical authority.
Primary request: Create six equal square straight-on orthographic samples in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid separated only by thin neutral-grey gutters, with no labels.
Top-left: matte titanium zinc shingle field, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no facade or opening.
Top-center: silver perforated metal veil, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete building element.
Top-right: pale architectural concrete plinth, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete ornament assembly.
Bottom-left: charcoal steel shadow joint and mullion, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete frame, door or screen.
Bottom-center: neutral low-iron museum atrium glass plus clean occupied depth seen dead-on, with clear floor, ceiling and restrained warm occupation, no exterior frame, mullion, screen, facade or skewed perspective.
Bottom-right: dark zinc seam and concealed drainage, authentic construction scale and evenly lit, no complete roof scene.
Scene/backdrop: flat evenly lit material-capture setup. Style/medium: premium physically based photoreal architectural construction texture reference.
Lighting: diffuse neutral overcast capture; no directional sunlight, baked shadow, vignette or perspective.
Constraints: exact 3 by 2 grid; every sample fills its cell edge-to-edge; no labels, text, logos or watermark; no complete facade or repeated window grid; match Image 1 exactly.
Avoid: cartoon materials, generic substitutions, oversized motifs, blue mirror glass, dramatic lighting, building perspective, decorative border.
